links.outcome: Physician question-answering accuracy and completion time with vs without LLM summaries
links.effect: Accuracy 88.0% with summaries vs 86.4% without; overall completion time not significantly reduced, though frequent summary use significantly sped completion (p = 0.002).
links.quote: Importantly, summary use maintained accuracy in answering clinical questions (88.0% with summaries vs. 86.4% without).

unlisted_practices: Extract-then-abstract summarization guided by disease-specific summary bundles
Customizable summary formats aligned with individual clinician workflows

screen.reason: The study conducts a simulated user study with physicians to evaluate the efficacy of an LLM-based EHR summarization tool compared to standard chart review, but it does not compare a specific operational deployment practice or safeguard.
